proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hsum : ∀ f : Fin 3 → V, ∑ l, f l = f i + f j + f k := by
    intro f
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;> simp_all <;> abel
  have hG : t.centroid = AffineMap.lineMap (t.points i) (midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)) (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    rw [t.centroid_eq_smul_sum_vsub_vadd i, hsum, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, midpoint_vsub]
    congr 1
    simp only [vsub_self, invOf_eq_inv]
    norm_num
    module
  refine ⟨hG, ?_⟩
  rw [hG, dist_left_lineMap, dist_lineMap_right]
  norm_num
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → t.centroid = AffineMap.lineMap (t.points i) (midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)) (2 / 3 : ℝ) ∧ dist (t.points i) t.centroid = 2 * dist t.centroid (midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k))
